user.title: Set up Sporet
user.description: Open sporet.no in a browser and sign in. Open the developer tools (F12), go to Application > Local Storage > sporet.no, click the row whose name starts with {storage_key}, and copy its value. Paste it below - it contains a refresh token, so this only has to be done once.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Sporet again
reauth_confirm.description: The saved login is no longer valid. Open sporet.no in a browser and sign in. Open the developer tools (F12), go to Application > Local Storage > sporet.no, click the row whose name starts with {storage_key}, and copy its value. Paste it below - it contains a refresh token, so this only has to be done once.
